result.title: Bridging Risk Approximation Gaps in Model Predictive Task Sampling via In-Context Modeling
result.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is essential for adaptive decision-making, e.g., robust Meta-RL and domain randomization (DR), and efficient post-training of large language models (LLMs), where tasks are commonly structured as Markov decision processes or prompts. A central bottleneck in all these settings is the cost of agent-environment interactions required for task selection and policy optimization. Model predictive task sampling (MPTS) has emerged as a promising approach to improve sample efficiency by querying informative tasks via a risk predictive model (RPM) trained on optimization history. However, existing RPMs suffer from two failure modes: (i) sparse optimization histories, which limit RPMs' generalization across the task space, and (ii) a one-step lag in risk approximation, which causes biased difficulty estimation as the policy evolves. This work formalizes these failure modes, derives lagged-risk decompositions that expose the resulting temporal bias, and recasts risk prediction as an in-context sequence modeling problem. The developed RPM integrates a one-step look-ahead mechanism with a temporal-weighted sliding window to mitigate data non-stationarity and scarcity, without requiring additional rollouts. Empirically, our approach yields more reliable difficulty estimates and consistent performance gains across robust Meta-RL, DR, and prompt curriculum RL post-training of LLMs.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作形式化 model predictive task sampling 中风险预测模型的两个失效模式（优化历史稀疏、风险近似滞后一步），将风险预测重构为 in-context 序列建模，并加入一步前瞻与时间加权滑动窗口，在 Meta-RL、域随机化和 LLM 提示课程后训练中提升样本效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 以「历史轨迹 + in-context 序列建模 + 前瞻」预测任务难度与收益的方法线索，可能可供核查地迁移到 latent 推理轨迹的贡献分配、训练任务筛选或推理价值的预测，但原文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，联系较间接。
